source ~/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate assistant_agent
cd ~/caiqiangyu/assistant_agent
PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,127.0.0.0/8,::1 \
MULTIMODAL_AGENT_PROVIDER_MODE=real \
MULTIMODAL_AGENT_MCP_CONFIG_PATH=mcp_servers.json \
python scripts/run_server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8089 --env-file .env
